answer: Slash-stake. Each participating agent posts a bond that the protocol automatically slashes whenever a jury marks its answer as low-quality or detects coordinated duplicate patterns across identities. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must continuously generate original high-quality work for every single identity while exposing the entire bond to irreversible slash on any failure, raising Sybil cost far above any reward. Inside the kernel of verification a bright plume of honest agents clusters into a dense grove of attested history that cheap parallel fakes cannot sustain.
